title: Jets own three of the top 13 picks in the 2027 NFL Draft after Week 9

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets own three of the top 13 picks in the 2027 NFL Draft after Week 9
sources.description: This season has gone completely off the rails for the New York Jets. One of the few silver linings is that the team is set to have multiple high first round picks. The Jets’ own pick will be high given the team’s struggles, and both the Indianapolis Colts and Dallas Cowboys are having difficult seasons. […]
